{{Top|leg}}
'''Tellar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. On the entry for the [[DL-6H heavy blaster pistol]], Tellar informed others that a weapons tech last seen at [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica]] was offering to modify the weapon's [[power cell]] housing to give it twenty extra shots. Tellar once rigged up a speartip with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite tape]] and fired it from a [[Firearc49 Speargun]]; the projectile blasted through the armored fortress gate of an underwater [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
